svg.title: Wooden 12 V bench — photographic assembly graphic

g.text: Overhead assembly study / 460 × 310 mm pine box / rear edge at top
12 V orange 5 V red 0 V charcoal 3V3 contact feed purple GPIO blue Pixel data green
Dashed leads stay parked. Drain COM → GPIO1, BALL HELD → GND, EMPTY open. Supplier photo montage; mounting and clearances need a physical fit check.
